M4 — 2026-09-16
macOS Seatbelt (/usr/bin/sandbox-exec), measured 2026-09-16 on macOS 27.0: (1) nesting works only with a byte-identical profile — applying any different profile inside a sandboxed process fails `sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted`, exit 71; so a tool that wraps children in sandbox-exec must itself run unsandboxed (a Claude Code Bash sandbox or an outer profile breaks it). (2) Profile paths match the resolved vnode path only: write `/private/var/folders` and `/private/tmp`, never `/var/folders` or `/tmp`, and realpath every entry. (3) `(allow default)(deny file-write*)(allow file-write* (subpath …))` is a working write allow-list; `(deny file-read* (subpath …))` seals reads; rm/mv/chmod/symlink-escape are all caught. The sofar-evaluator repo (~/IO/sofar-evaluator, self-improve 3.1) encodes these; its `selftest` command proves them on the current machine.
